Introduction

This 
document details the equipment inspection 
I1, which must be performed 
on every six months as indicated
by M6 in the title block.

Mazout unloading Pump is used to transfer Mazout from pipes to storage 
tanks

The first draft initiated by eng. Emad El din Ali Abd Alla, accepted by eng. 
Mokhtar Abdel Latef general director, revised by EDEPC quality control eng. 
Samir Abd El-Gelil, approved by eng. Mokhter Abd El Latif Abu Soltan Power 
Station Head Sector, and certified by eng. Aly Mostafa Al Lethy EDEPC inspection 
& quality control head sector.

sections.text: Safety Precautions

A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,
Safety fence with caution marks must be surrounding the work area,

Wear safety 
 and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc

Isolate the
circuit breaker for Motor of this Pump 
 when work on the Pump.

Isolate the
electrical cable Bearing of the Motor of this Pump

The Pump must be is Isolated mechanically by closing suction and 
delivery valves and drain it.
